title.ms: Akta meminda Seksyen 1 Akta Republik No. 4705

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6087_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby authorized to be appropriated out of the savings of the Bureau or Office concerned such sums as may be necessary to implement this Act. Thereafter, the sums necessary for the purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 4, 1969.
